title: Are Final Market Prices Sufficient for Information Aggregation? Evidence from Last-Minute Dynamics in Parimutuel Betting
abstract: arXiv:2509.14645v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This study presents evidence challenging the practice of inferring risk preferences, probability perceptions, and beliefs from parimutuel betting markets, where wagers cannot be made contingent on final odds. Using interim odds from horse racing, we show that expected returns depend not only on final odds but also on the path through which they are reached: horses with final-five-minute odds declines earn higher realized returns than horses with similar final odds. We rationalize this path dependence using a two-period extension of the information-based model \`{a} la Ottaviani--S{\o}rensen, in which final-stage odds declines arise from informed bettors' late wagers based on private signals. The model also highlights that final odds--return patterns alone may not distinguish information aggregation from probability distortions.

translated_title: 最终市场价格是否足以实现信息聚合？来自彩池投注最后时刻动态的证据
translated_abstract: 本研究提供了挑战从彩池投注市场中推断风险偏好、概率感知和信念的证据，因为在该市场中投注不能基于最终赔率进行。利用赛马中的临时赔率，我们表明预期回报不仅取决于最终赔率，还取决于达到最终赔率的路径：最终五分钟赔率下降的马匹，其实际回报高于具有相似最终赔率的马匹。我们通过基于奥蒂亚维尼-索伦森信息模型的二期扩展来解释这种路径依赖性，其中最终阶段赔率下降源于知情投注者基于私人信号的后期投注。该模型还强调，仅凭最终赔率-回报模式可能无法区分信息聚合与概率扭曲。
tldr: 本文通过赛马彩池投注数据揭示，最终赔率不足以完全反映信息聚合，赔率变化路径（如最后时刻下降）对回报有显著影响，且模型表明最终赔率-回报模式无法单独区分信息聚合与概率扭曲。
en_tdlr: This paper shows via horse-racing parimutuel data that final odds alone insufficiently capture information aggregation, as the path of odds changes (e.g., last-minute declines) significantly affects returns, and the model indicates final odds-return patterns cannot alone distinguish information aggregation from probability distortions.
